title: Taxi to Nowhere (3am)
style: lo-fi soul, Rhodes piano, sparse kick, rain ambience, intimate male vocal, mild reverb, slow groove, bittersweet resolve, late night, warm tape
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Meter off, I told him just drive
Don't need a destination to feel alive
City lights bleed into the wet
Easiest thing I've done yet

[Verse 2]
No one's waiting at the other end
No apology left to send
Just the road and the radio low
Playing something from years ago

[Chorus]
Taxi to nowhere, 3am
I'm not lost I'm just not going back again
Taxi to nowhere, fare's on me
Some rides are just about being free
